segments.text: Welcome to UX Army. In this video, we
will show you how to view and analyze
the reports of your usability tests.
Let's say you have received some
responses from the last time you
launched your test. To open the results
page, hover over the test you would like
to check and click on the view report
button. You can also open this page by
clicking on the results board when you
are in the test creation board. In this
page, you can find all kind of details
about this test. On the first viewport,
test overview, you can see a snapshot of
your test results, including the type of
test, response duration, number of
responses, and demographic of your
participants. You'll also see the number
of video recordings available, allowing
you to watch interactions, and listen as
participants share their thoughts and
feelings during the test. We'll get back
into this section later in the video. On
the left, you can see a special feature,
AI summary.
This is where we leverage the power of
AI in your unmodderated usability tests.
This feature uses audio recordings from
the responses to quickly summarize all
user feedback across participants,
automatically categorizing responses as
positive, neutral, or negative. It also
highlights key findings for each task,
giving you a clear and actionable
overview in seconds. Below, you'll find
an overview of each individual task. You
can click on each task to explore more
details. For task one, prototype
testing, you'll notice a success rate
indicator. This is directly tied to the
success metrics you defined when setting
up your test, providing a clear
reflection of task performance. You can
also view the navigation
[Music]
tree and heat map in this type of task.
You can switch the viewport to task
overview to review the results for each
task individually. Alternatively, switch
to response overview to see detailed
results from each
participant. Now get back to the video
recording section. You will get the
recordings from participants if you
choose the advanced usability testing
option in the first place when you
create the test. In the video
recordings, you can observe interactions
and hear participants express their
thoughts and feelings throughout the
test. You can download the recordings,
take notes, create short reels,
bookmark, and even share the recordings
with your team for
collaboration. To switch between
recordings, simply use the participant
button. On the right portion of the
page, you'll find tools to help analyze
responses effectively. The first tab is
the AI summary. Besides the test
overview level, we also provide a
summary in the individual response level
that helps you quickly scan the response
of each participant. In the tasks tab,
you can review the responses of all the
tasks. Access the notes and short reels
you've created in annotations and video
clips to keep track of key
observations. UX Army offers auto
transcription and inplatform translation
to streamline your analysis. You can
highlight content, create
tags, and filter key findings to
organize insights seamlessly within the
analysis
[Music]
space. Hope that this video can help you
view and analyze your test results on UX
Army platform. Thank you for watching.
